surface.name: RECORD
surface.meaning: Canonical public receipt-record index on a11oy.net. Pointers only. Not a receipt database. Not an interactive verifier.

reader_guide: The signed RECORD index lives at https://a11oy.net/record/. The tool that checks a record is https://a-11-oy.com/verify. They are different hosts and must not be merged. This repository has no receipt store. Live receipts are on the product Space (Khipu + /data SZLHOLDINGS/szl-evidence + /api/lake/v1/receipts). This file lists those locations. receipt_ids is empty and UNAVAILABLE: that is not a measured zero, and no receipt identifiers are invented here. Never a11oy.com.

interactive_verifier.scope: Interactive /verify stays on the product origin. This origin links to it and does not clone the tool.

public_key.scope: Org-published cosign public key listing. This file does not re-verify signatures.

status.meaning: This index lists receipt locations. It is not a receipt database. Live receipts stay on the product Space. Hash-chain and signature checks are not executed by a11oy.net. Live chain state remains UNAVAILABLE here. An empty receipt-id listing is UNAVAILABLE, not a measured zero.

live_store.meaning: This GitHub Pages repository has no receipt store and does not duplicate the product database. Live receipts stay on the product Space.

runtime.scope: Product origin. a11oy.net is GitHub Pages, not a product host.

khipu.scope: Khipu ledger paths live under the product Space /data mount. This origin does not run Khipu.

persistence.scope: Attached on the product Space. Not re-hosted here. Not treated as a public dataset listing on this page.

query_api.scope: Must be observed on the product origin. This origin does not host /api/lake.

stores.name: governed-receipts-bench
stores.scope: Corpus location only. This origin does not re-run the bench.
